attributes.cti_reports: public CTI reports that name the value (ORKL, P293): list of {title, publisher, date, date_source, url, orkl_sources, actors, report_sha1}, most recent first, at most 10; publisher links only, no report files
attributes.cti_report_count: number of CTI reports listed in cti_reports
attributes.cti_reports_fuzzy_dropped: number of fuzzy search hits dropped because they do not name the queried value (ORKL search is fuzzy)
attributes.report_iocs: opt-in IOC mining of report texts (P293 cond 5): list of {report, date, iocs, warninglisted, truncated, chars_scanned, error}; the IOCs are expand=False pivots, never verdicts
attributes.cti_news_mentions: headline-only matches of the value in curated CTI news / advisory feeds (P298): list of {feed, source, title, link, published, matched, why, kind, label, severity}, most recent first
attributes.cti_feed_health: per-feed health of the CTI news watcher (P298 cond 9): {feed: {state ok | stale | blocked | error | missing | not_refreshed, newest_item, age_days, items, tier, label, reason}}
attributes.ransomware_cve_card: ransomware exploitation context of a CVE (P372): {label 'reported exploited by ransomware groups X, Y', status 'reported', groups, unresolved_groups, sources [{label, url}], products, kev_known_ransomware_use, patch_priority, attribution}
attributes.patch_priority: patch priority hint from ransomware exploitation context: highest (matrix names groups and CISA KEV says known ransomware use) | raised (either one) | normal
attributes.ransomware_tool_leads: tools a ransomware group was reported to use in intrusions (BushidoUK Tool Matrix): list of {tool, category, note, lolrmm, attack_software_id}; hunting leads tagged dual_use, never malicious verdicts
attributes.ransomware_exploited_cves: CVEs a ransomware group was reported to exploit (BushidoUK Vulnerability Matrix): list of {cve, product, sources}
attributes.ransomware_groups_unresolved: group names of the ransomware matrices that the actor alias index could not resolve (listed, never guessed; doctor)
attributes.matrix_versions: versions of the local ransomware matrix copies: {file: {etag, fetched_at, sha256}} (raw.githubusercontent.com gives no commit date)
attributes.sigma_rules: SigmaHQ detection rules (metadata only, DRL 1.1) for a technique, CVE or name: list of {id, title, status, level, logsource, link, marked}, stable/test first
attributes.atomic_tests: Atomic Red Team tests for a technique (MIT): list of {technique, number, name, guid, executor, tactics, link}; links only, never executed
attributes.detection_coverage: detection and validation coverage label of a technique, CVE or name: 'N Sigma rules / N atomic tests'
attributes.sigma_release: SigmaHQ release the local Sigma index was built from: {tag, release_date, label, commit, rules}
attributes.cisa_advisories: CISA cybersecurity advisories (incl. #StopRansomware) that name the value: list of {advisory_id, title, published, link, family, stop_ransomware, ioc_file}; US Government work (public domain)
attributes.cisa_ioc_matches: matches of the value in local CISA advisory IOC files: list of {advisory_id, published, tags, historical, matchable_as_malicious}
attributes.cisa_families_unresolved: family / actor names of CISA advisories that the actor alias index could not resolve (listed, never guessed)

tags.dual_use: legitimate or dual-use tool (RMM, file transfer, admin utility) reported in intrusions: a hunting lead, never a malicious verdict
tags.reported_claim: a third-party report or actor claim naming the organisation: verify, never a confirmed incident
tags.cisa_advisory: indicator or fact taken from a CISA cybersecurity advisory (US Government, public domain)
tags.unverified_source: comes from an unknown-tier source (operator not verified): label only, context

relations.reported_in: value -> public report (publisher URL) that names it; context, not investigated
relations.co_mentioned_in_report: value -> indicator mined from the same public report (low confidence, never a verdict)
relations.mentioned_in_news: value -> news / advisory article whose headline names it (headline-only match)
